svg.title: At a strict imaginary-time configuration the phase values are continuous in χ and have the unselected value as their integral. For a joint Schwartz test f and fixed strict heights y, the preced- ing bound gives the integrable dominator Ck−m|f(x)|. Dominated convergence therefore proves R Wχ(v; x + iy)f(x)dx. The same bound, combined with the probability normal- continuity of χ 7→ ization of the phase measure, makes the double integral absolutely integrable. Fubini transfers the character integral inside the x-integral and yields the unselected strict smeared wave.
